source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

MODEL_PATH="/root/autodl-tmp/models/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B"

CKA_PATH="results/cka_scores.pt"
ABLATION_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/alpha_ablation"
SFT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/sft_ablation"
RESULT_DIR="results/alpha_ablation"
SPARSITY=0.20
EVAL_SAMPLES=100

mkdir -p "$ABLATION_DIR" "$SFT_DIR" "$RESULT_DIR"

ALPHAS=(0.0 0.5 1.0 2.0 4.0)

echo "=========================================="
echo "Full Alpha Ablation Pipeline"

echo "Sparsity: ${SPARSITY}, Eval samples: ${EVAL_SAMPLES}"

# === Phase 0: Compute importance + CKA scores if missing ===
if [ ! -f "$IMPORTANCE_PATH" ]; then
    echo "[PHASE 0] Computing importance scores... $(date '+%H:%M:%S')"
    python src/importance_score.py \
        --model_path "$MODEL_PATH" \
        --output_path "$IMPORTANCE_PATH" \
        --n_samples 256 \
        --dtype bfloat16
    echo "[DONE] Importance scores: $(date '+%H:%M:%S')"
else
    echo "[SKIP] importance_scores.pt exists"
fi

if [ ! -f "$CKA_PATH" ]; then
    echo "[PHASE 0] Computing CKA scores... $(date '+%H:%M:%S')"
    python src/cka_overlap.py \
        --model_path "$MODEL_PATH" \
        --output_path "$CKA_PATH" \
        --n_samples 256 \
        --dtype bfloat16
    echo "[DONE] CKA scores: $(date '+%H:%M:%S')"
else
    echo "[SKIP] cka_scores.pt exists"
fi

# === Phase A: Prune for each alpha (2 GPUs parallel) ===
echo ""
echo "=== Phase A: Pruning ==="

gpu_queue_0=()
gpu_queue_1=()
for alpha in "${ALPHAS[@]}"; do
    tag="alpha_${alpha}"
    if [ -f "${ABLATION_DIR}/${tag}/config.json" ]; then
        echo "[SKIP] Prune ${tag} already done"

        gpu_queue_0+=("$alpha")
    else
        gpu_queue_1+=("$alpha")
    fi

echo ""
echo "=== Phase A: Post-prune Eval (N=${EVAL_SAMPLES}) ==="

eval_queue_1=()

    tag="alpha_${alpha}"

    if [ -f "$eval_path" ]; then
        echo "[SKIP] Eval prune ${tag} already done"
        continue
    fi
    if (( ${#eval_queue_0[@]} <= ${#eval_queue_1[@]} )); then
        eval_queue_0+=("$alpha")

    fi

    for alpha in "${alphas[@]}"; do
